note: The selector grammar, recorded once. `crates/parcad-core/src/selectors.rs` parses selectors for the kernel and `app/src/selectors.ts` parses them for the editor; both are tested against this file so the two cannot disagree about what a selector means. `terms` is the canonical source form of each parsed term. `span` is a byte range into the authored string, used to underline the offending text. Every case states both the edge and the vertex result, because the two entry points reject different things. `queries` does the same for query objects: `error` is what `check_query_shape` (Rust) and `queryShapeError` (TypeScript) both say about one, or null when both read it.
